name: Emma McCollough
source:
An approachable, passionate violinist, Emma prides herself in being the 'friendly face' of the music club.

Though her energetic nature is often charming, her ability to toy with her clubmates' emotions is second to none.

As the time spent with her friends starts to become a memory, she holds dear to the goal of making their final performance together a success.

[From Twitter]
